extras.name: Denver
extras.note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the South Platte and the Front Range carry the fit; the 1908 staged sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool, drawn from the north (the Twenty-Third Street Viaduct, ~1.3 km north of the point) looking south - the grid dense and legible to the southern suburbs, the Front Range along the southern horizon, a printed landmark index - spanning the whole city beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)

files.artist: Birdseye View Publishing Co.; Denver Lith. Co.
files.desc: Perspective map not drawn to scale. Includes illus. and index to points of interest. LC Panoramic maps (2nd ed.), 66 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. AACR2: 651/1; 710/1
